summary: Valaris, a Bermuda-domiciled offshore driller, filed an 8-K confirming that on September 30, 2026 it and Transocean received DOJ Antitrust Division notice closing the HSR Act investigation, with the waiting period expired. Under the February 9, 2026 Business Combination Agreement, Transocean will acquire all outstanding Valaris common shares for 15.235 Transocean shares each, a stock-for-stock merger. Closing is anticipated in Q4 2026, subject to remaining customary conditions. The filing names no board recommendation or advisor. Watch for shareholder vote, remaining regulatory clearances beyond US HSR, and any renegotiation or termination risk given the fixed exchange ratio.
